facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports that the government introduced its personal data legal framework in 2023 through Ordinance-Law No. 23/010, the Digital Code, which sets out lawful processing, transparency, data minimisation and system security, and treats it as the framework within which DPOs ensure compliance; the report gives no date for the statement, so the published date of 2026-03-17 is used.

The Ministry of Digital Economy launched a national Data Protection Officers (DPO) network in Kinshasa to build professional capacity and promote best practice in personal data protection, with Minister Augustin Kibassa Maliba presiding; no sanction or decision is reported; the report gives no event date, so the published date of 2026-03-17 is used.

The report says the DPO network forms part of the national data governance effort 'aligned with ... plans to establish a dedicated Data Protection Authority', so the authority is planned and not yet established; no date is given for the statement, so the published date of 2026-03-17 is used.
